source.title: The editor's desk
source.body:
<!-- curiouser:desk -->
**Thursday 12 November**, as of 09:44.

✅ **No. 9, “The Waiter Who Forgot the Bill”** (The Zeigarnik effect) was checked, corrected and released at 06:05. 58 claims and 4 links checked, 4 changes. See [the check](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/blob/main/content/checks/0009.json).
  - rabbit hole, 'The urge to go back', paragraph 2: “A 2025 meta-analysis by Riccardo Ghibellini and Beat Meier” → “A 2025 meta-analysis by Romain Ghibellini and Beat Meier”. The first author's name is Romain Ghibellini (University of Bern).
  - rabbit hole, further reading, third item (author): “Riccardo Ghibellini and Beat Meier, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (2025)” → “Romain Ghibellini and Beat Meier, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (2025)”. Same author name correction.
  - sources, fourth item (title): “Riccardo Ghibellini and Beat Meier, 'Interruption, recall and resumption” → “Romain Ghibellini and Beat Meier, 'Interruption, recall and resumption”. Same author name correction.
  - story, paragraph 3: “In her first experiment, 32 adults each worked through 22 small tasks” → “In her first experiment, 32 adults each worked through 18 to 22 small tasks”. Zeigarnik's own paper says each subject was given 'from 18 to 22 tasks'. MacLeod's review rounds this to 22.

## Waiting for you (4)

- **Video to post** for No. 1 “The Great Hanoi Rat Hunt” (52 seconds; the free AI voice): [download the video](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/releases/download/videos/curiouser-0001.mp4) · [captions file](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/releases/download/videos/curiouser-0001.srt). The caption to paste is at the bottom of this page. Nothing is posted for you.
- **Pull request** [#6 Sunday-morning reminder for the Caucus-race](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/pull/6). Merging it is your approval, and sends it to readers' phones.
- **Weekly report** for Wednesday 11 November: [read it](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/blob/main/reports/2026-11-11.md).
- **Marketing brief** for Thursday 12 November: [read it](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/blob/main/marketing/2026-11-12.md). Answer in [How the posts did](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/issues/8); silence means no.

## Everything else

- 🎬 **Video** for No. 1 “The Great Hanoi Rat Hunt”, made today (52 seconds; the free AI voice): [download the video](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/releases/download/videos/curiouser-0001.mp4) · [captions file](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/releases/download/videos/curiouser-0001.srt)
- 🔧 **Pull requests:** [#6 Sunday-morning reminder for the Caucus-race](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/pull/6)
- ✉️ **Support:** not switched on. It needs an address for readers to write to.
- 📊 **Weekly report:** [Wednesday 11 November](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/blob/main/reports/2026-11-11.md)
- 📣 **Marketing brief:** [Thursday 12 November](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/blob/main/marketing/2026-11-12.md). Report how posts did, or answer the brief, in [How the posts did](https://github.com/TuckyPsyc/Curiouser/issues/8).
- 🩺 **Automation that failed in the last day:** none.

### Caption to paste under the video for No. 1

Press and hold to select it, then copy.

```
A bounty meant to wipe out rats ended with people breeding them. That's Goodhart's law: once a number becomes the target, it stops telling you the truth.

#goodhartslaw #history #economics #truestory #learnontiktok #curiouser

Narrated by an AI voice.
```
